caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a long, flowing robe or dress with elaborate decorative elements, rendered primarily in shades of gray on an off-white or beige background. The main object, centered near the top of the composition, is a full-length garment with a high, round neckline and an open front that is edged with a broad, scalloped lace trim ornamented with floral embroidery. The sleeves of the robe are wide and end in large ruffled cuffs with additional lace trim, and each shoulder is adorned with a prominent ruffle. A small patch pocket is visible on the left side of the garment, also embellished with lace. Below the central depiction, two detailed studies are included: on the lower left, a close-up of the garment's upper back showing the ruffled collar and lace; on the lower right, an enlarged view of the lace trim, detailing the intricate floral patterns and scalloped edges. The entire drawing uses subtle gray tones for shading and detail, and all elements are outlined distinctly against the light, neutral background.
title: Nightgown
